What was Sonia Gandhi's first meeting with Indira Gandhi like? Why did Sonia Gandhi reportedly become emotional when she first met her future mother-in-law? In her new memoir, Belonging: A Journey of Love, Sonia Gandhi revisits some deeply personal memories from her life. The book offers an account of her early days in India, her relationship with Rajiv Gandhi and her first encounter with the Gandhi family. It also recalls her first meeting with former Prime Minister Indira Gandhi and reveals what happened during that memorable moment.
